text: APPROVE. The extraction moves the pattern-resolution logic unchanged into `ResolveGoEmbedPattern`, with each `continue` becoming `return null` and the caller adding only non-null results. That keeps behaviour identical and removes the nested `if`s, ternary and `||` from `CollectGoEmbedRefs`, which should bring it well under 15. I could only see the diff, not the full file or a build, so the build and the exact complexity score are inferred. I assumed `HostEmbedRef` is a reference type (record or class) and that nullable annotations are already enabled in the project.
